// Function alias: YumaAIRegister   (deployed as a workspace saved function by deploy/register-infra.json)
// Current AI agent register (ISM-2134, ISM-2135) built from the custom table AIAgentRegister_CL.
// Writers: PB4 (daily AgentsInfo sync), PB2 (consent decisions), manual entries through the same DCR stream.
// One row per agent, with ISM-2135 field gaps, ISM-2133 identity gap, high-risk permissions and ISM-2138 review status.
let HighRisk = dynamic([
    "Application.ReadWrite.All", "AppRoleAssignment.ReadWrite.All", "Directory.ReadWrite.All",
    "AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All", "DelegatedPermissionGrant.ReadWrite.All",
    "RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory", "User.ReadWrite.All", "Group.ReadWrite.All",
    "Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess", "Mail.Read", "Mail.ReadWrite", "Mail.Send",
    "MailboxSettings.ReadWrite", "full_access_as_app", "EWS.AccessAsUser.All",
    "Files.Read.All", "Files.ReadWrite.All", "Sites.Read.All", "Sites.ReadWrite.All",
    "Sites.FullControl.All", "Chat.Read.All", "Chat.ReadWrite.All", "ChannelMessage.Read.All"]);
let ReviewCycle = 182d;   // ISM-2138: at least every six months
let Records = AIAgentRegister_CL;
let Snapshot = Records
    | where RecordType == "RegisterSnapshot"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, AgentName, Source, Platform, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, EntraAgentId,
                        EntraBlueprintId, Owners, BusinessPurpose, Identities, Permissions, DeclaredTools, McpServers,
                        DataSources, SharedWith, LifecycleStatus, RiskRating)
             by AgentKey
    | project-rename LastSnapshotAt = TimeGenerated;
let Decisions = Records
    | where RecordType == "ConsentDecision"
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, Decision, DecisionBy, DecisionReason, ConsentType, IsAdminConsent, ConsentedBy,
                        ConsentDate, IncidentArmId)
             by AgentKey
    | project-rename LastDecisionAt = TimeGenerated;
let Lifecycle = Records
    | extend ReviewTime = iff(RecordType in ("ReviewCompleted", "ConsentDecision"), coalesce(LastReviewDate, TimeGenerated), datetime(null))
    | summarize FirstRecorded = min(TimeGenerated),
                LastReview = max(ReviewTime),
                RetiredAt = maxif(TimeGenerated, RecordType == "Retired"),
                ConsentEvents = countif(RecordType == "ConsentDecision")
             by AgentKey;
Snapshot
| join kind=leftouter Decisions on AgentKey
| join kind=leftouter Lifecycle on AgentKey
| project-away AgentKey1, AgentKey2
| where isnull(RetiredAt) or RetiredAt < LastSnapshotAt
| extend NextReviewDue = LastReview + ReviewCycle
| extend ReviewStatus = case(isnull(LastReview), "Never reviewed",
                             NextReviewDue < now(), "Overdue",
                             NextReviewDue < now() + 30d, "Due within 30 days",
                             "Current")
| extend HighRiskPermissions = set_intersect(extract_all(@"([A-Za-z_]+(?:\.[A-Za-z]+)+|full_access_as_app)", tostring(Permissions)), HighRisk)
| extend Gap_NoOwner = coalesce(array_length(Owners), 0) == 0,
         Gap_NoPurpose = isempty(BusinessPurpose),
         Gap_NoUniqueIdentity = isempty(EntraAgentId) and isempty(ServicePrincipalId),
         Gap_NoPermissionsRecorded = isempty(tostring(Permissions)) or tostring(Permissions) in ("[]", "{}"),
         Flag_HighRiskPermissions = array_length(HighRiskPermissions) > 0,
         Flag_HasMcp = coalesce(array_length(McpServers), 0) > 0
| extend GapCount = toint(Gap_NoOwner) + toint(Gap_NoPurpose) + toint(Gap_NoUniqueIdentity) + toint(Gap_NoPermissionsRecorded)
| project AgentKey, AgentName, Source, Platform, AppId, ServicePrincipalId, EntraAgentId, EntraBlueprintId, Owners,
          BusinessPurpose, Identities, Permissions, HighRiskPermissions, DeclaredTools, McpServers, DataSources, SharedWith,
          LifecycleStatus, RiskRating, Decision, DecisionBy, DecisionReason, ConsentType, IsAdminConsent, ConsentedBy,
          ConsentDate, IncidentArmId, ConsentEvents, FirstRecorded, LastSnapshotAt, LastDecisionAt, LastReview,
          NextReviewDue, ReviewStatus, Gap_NoOwner, Gap_NoPurpose, Gap_NoUniqueIdentity, Gap_NoPermissionsRecorded,
          Flag_HighRiskPermissions, Flag_HasMcp, GapCount
variables.$fxv#4:
// Function alias: YumaISMControlStatus   (saved function; depends on YumaAIRegister and watchlist YumaISMControlMap)
// One row per ISM control in scope (ISM-2133 to 2140, ISM-2156 to 2159) with an evidence status computed from data.
// Status meanings: "Evidence present" = the data shows the expected state; "Gap" = the data shows a problem;
//   "No data" = the source table is empty or missing; "Attestation required" = needs a human statement plus the metric.
// This is evidence to support an assessment, not a compliance determination.
// Tables that are not connected are tolerated with union isfuzzy=true and count as "No data".
let Lookback = 30d;
let Reg = YumaAIRegister();
let RegTotal = toscalar(Reg | count);
let RegNoIdentity = toscalar(Reg | where Gap_NoUniqueIdentity | count);
let RegWithGaps = toscalar(Reg | where GapCount > 0 | count);
let RegReviewDue = toscalar(Reg | where ReviewStatus in ("Overdue", "Never reviewed") | count);
let RegHighRisk = toscalar(Reg | where Flag_HighRiskPermissions | count);
let RegLastWrite = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AIAgentRegister_CL | summarize t = max(TimeGenerated)), (print t = datetime(null)) | summarize max(t));
let YumaAlerts = union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityAlert
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
         | where AlertName startswith "Yuma AIA-"
         | extend DetectionId = extract(@"Yuma AIA-(D\d+)", 1, AlertName)
         | summarize n = count() by DetectionId),
        (datatable(DetectionId:string, n:long)[]);
let AlertsFor = (id:string) { toscalar(YumaAlerts | where DetectionId == id | summarize tolong(sum(n))) };
let MsInjectionAlerts = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SecurityAlert | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) | where AlertName has_any ("prompt injection", "jailbreak") | summarize n = count()),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let UserConsents = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (AuditLogs
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
         | where OperationName =~ "Consent to application" and Result =~ "success"
         | mv-expand TargetResource = TargetResources
         | mv-expand Prop = TargetResource.modifiedProperties
         | where tostring(Prop.displayName) == "ConsentContext.IsAdminConsent" and tostring(Prop.newValue) has "False"
         | summarize n = dcount(CorrelationId)),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AuditRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AuditLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let SpSignInRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let GraphRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AgenticNetRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (NetworkAccessTraffic | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) and IsAgentic == true | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let CopilotRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (CopilotActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let SigninRows = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d) | summarize n = count()), (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let DeviceCode = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) and AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode" | summarize n = count()),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let DeviceCodeUsers = toscalar(union isfuzzy=true
        (SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback) and AuthenticationProtocol =~ "deviceCode" | summarize n = dcount(UserPrincipalName)),
        (print n = tolong(0)) | summarize sum(n));
let AgentCA = union isfuzzy=true
        (AADServicePrincipalSignInLogs
         | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
         | extend AgentType = tostring(parse_json(Agent).agentType)
         | where isnotempty(AgentType) and AgentType !~ "notAgentic"
         | summarize Total = count(), NotApplied = countif(ConditionalAccessStatus =~ "notApplied")),
        (datatable(Total:long, NotApplied:long)[]);
let AgentSignIns = toscalar(AgentCA | summarize tolong(sum(Total)));
let AgentNoCA = toscalar(AgentCA | summarize tolong(sum(NotApplied)));
let Rows = union
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2133",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegNoIdentity == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegNoIdentity, " of ", RegTotal, " registered agents have no unique Entra identity"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D07"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2134",
           Status = case(isnull(RegLastWrite), "No data", RegLastWrite > ago(7d), "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat("Register last written ", format_datetime(RegLastWrite, "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), " UTC; ", RegTotal, " active agents"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2135",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegWithGaps == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegWithGaps, " of ", RegTotal, " agents missing owner, purpose, identity or permissions"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2136",
           Status = case(coalesce(AgentSignIns, 0) == 0, "No data", "Attestation required"),
           Metric = strcat(coalesce(AgentNoCA, 0), " of ", coalesce(AgentSignIns, 0), " agentic service principal sign-ins had no Conditional Access applied (30d)"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D07"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2137",
           Status = case(AuditRows == 0, "No data", UserConsents == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(UserConsents, " user (non-admin) app consents in 90 days"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D05"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2138",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegReviewDue == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(RegReviewDue, " of ", RegTotal, " agents overdue or never reviewed (6-month cycle)"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2139",
           Status = case(AuditRows > 0 and SpSignInRows > 0 and GraphRows > 0, "Evidence present", AuditRows > 0, "Gap", "No data"),
           Metric = strcat("Last 24h rows: AuditLogs ", AuditRows, "; service principal sign-ins ", SpSignInRows, "; Graph activity ", GraphRows),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2140",
           Status = case(SigninRows == 0, "No data", DeviceCode == 0, "Evidence present", "Gap"),
           Metric = strcat(DeviceCode, " device code sign-ins by ", DeviceCodeUsers, " users in 30 days"),
           AlertsLookback = tolong(0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2156",
           Status = case(RegTotal == 0, "No data", RegHighRisk == 0, "Evidence present", "Attestation required"),
           Metric = strcat(RegHighRisk, " agents hold high-risk permissions; justify each or reduce"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D04"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2157",
           Status = "Attestation required",
           Metric = strcat(coalesce(AlertsFor("D08"), 0), " agent Graph data-burst alerts in 30 days"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D08"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2158",
           Status = "Attestation required",
           Metric = strcat(MsInjectionAlerts, " prompt-injection or jailbreak alerts; ", coalesce(AlertsFor("D10"), 0), " followed by exfil-like activity (30d)"),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D10"), 0)),
    (print ControlId = "ISM-2159",
           Status = case(GraphRows > 0 and (AgenticNetRows > 0 or CopilotRows > 0), "Evidence present", GraphRows > 0 or AgenticNetRows > 0 or CopilotRows > 0, "Gap", "No data"),
           Metric = strcat("Last 24h rows: Graph activity ", GraphRows, "; GSA agentic traffic ", AgenticNetRows, "; CopilotActivity ", CopilotRows),
           AlertsLookback = coalesce(AlertsFor("D15"), 0));
Rows
| join kind=leftouter (_GetWatchlist("YumaISMControlMap") | project ControlId, Control, Theme, PackEvidence, EvidenceMethod) on ControlId
| project-away ControlId1
| extend CheckedAtUtc = now()
| project ControlId, Theme, Control, Status, Metric, AlertsLookback, PackEvidence, EvidenceMethod, CheckedAtUtc
| order by ControlId asc
variables.$fxv#5:
// Function alias: YumaEvidenceRegisterCsv   (saved function; used by PB5 ISM evidence export)
// Returns one row, one column (Csv): the full agent register as RFC 4180 CSV.
let q = (s:string) { strcat('"', replace_string(s, '"', '""'), '"') };
let Header = "AgentKey,AgentName,Source,Platform,AppId,ServicePrincipalId,EntraAgentId,Owners,BusinessPurpose,Identities,Permissions,HighRiskPermissions,DeclaredTools,McpServers,DataSources,SharedWith,Decision,DecisionBy,ConsentType,ConsentedBy,ConsentDate,LastReview,NextReviewDue,ReviewStatus,GapCount,Gap_NoOwner,Gap_NoPurpose,Gap_NoUniqueIdentity,Gap_NoPermissionsRecorded";
YumaAIRegister()
| order by AgentName asc
| extend Line = strcat_array(pack_array(
      q(AgentKey), q(AgentName), q(Source), q(Platform), q(AppId), q(ServicePrincipalId), q(EntraAgentId),
      q(tostring(Owners)), q(BusinessPurpose), q(tostring(Identities)), q(tostring(Permissions)),
      q(tostring(HighRiskPermissions)), q(tostring(DeclaredTools)), q(tostring(McpServers)), q(tostring(DataSources)),
      q(tostring(SharedWith)), q(Decision), q(DecisionBy), q(ConsentType), q(ConsentedBy),
      q(format_datetime(ConsentDate, "yyyy-MM-dd")), q(format_datetime(LastReview, "yyyy-MM-dd")),
      q(format_datetime(NextReviewDue, "yyyy-MM-dd")), q(ReviewStatus), q(tostring(GapCount)),
      q(tostring(Gap_NoOwner)), q(tostring(Gap_NoPurpose)), q(tostring(Gap_NoUniqueIdentity)),
      q(tostring(Gap_NoPermissionsRecorded))), ",")
| summarize Lines = make_list(Line, 100000)
| project Csv = strcat(Header, "\n", strcat_array(Lines, "\n"))

dataFlows.transformKql: source | extend TimeGenerated = iff(isnull(TimeGenerated), now(), TimeGenerated)
